commands.command:
. /workspace/.setup/rust-env.sh
python3 tools/wtime-bench/compare.py --baseline target/performance/P030-before --candidate tools/wtime-bench/target/release/wtime-bench --candidate-mode decoded --selection scalar --pairs 30 --build-growth-explanation-file docs/benchmarks/performance/P030-build-decision.md --output target/performance/P030 > target/performance/P030-run.log 2>&1
commands.name: comparison

counts.warm_calibration_policy_limit: Typed scalar workloads use bounded shared-batch confirmation with both sides at or above 20 ms during calibration. Later timed observations can fall below 20 ms. The three legacy scalar controls retain the uncalibrated common MIN one-shot estimate and have no 20 ms guarantee.

comparison.warm_calibration_limit: Typed scalar workloads use bounded shared-batch confirmation with both sides at or above 20 ms during calibration. Later timed observations can fall below 20 ms. The three legacy scalar controls retain the uncalibrated common MIN one-shot estimate and have no 20 ms guarantee.

coverage_limits: The scalar workload and stage totals are derived from the immutable registry and independently checked against the journal.
Only the single validated guest-frame entry point is eligible for the candidate-path claim; public, host, indirect, and reference boundaries remain controls.
Focused path proof and full suites are correctness evidence; speed claims require the separate predeclared gate result.

Typed scalar warm calls use bounded shared-batch calibration with both sides confirmed at or above 20 ms. Later timing observations may be shorter; the three legacy controls retain uncalibrated common-MIN batching.
